sections.title: Pólya urns, beta prediction and predictive updating

missing_pieces.duty: ED26-P15-CH-polya-urns-and-beta-prediction-C007 (partial): The full proof promised by proved=annex:p15.polya-posterior-prediction is not completely written. Annex lines 175-182 assert that every future indicator has conditional mean a/T and variance ab/T^2, and that every distinct future pair has conditional joint success probability a(a+1)/(T(T+1)). They then add these to get E(K_{n,m}|F_n)=ma/T and Var(K_{n,m}|F_n)=mab(T+m)/(T^2(T+1)). The written argument (lines 167-173) only gives the conditional probability of a specified future word. It never derives the conditional marginal of B_{n+j} for j>=2 or of a non-adjacent pair: no conditional exchangeability of the future given the past, no marginalization over intermediate draws, no martingale step, and no appeal to the conditional Bernoulli product of thm:p15-polya-beta-limit. The conditional mean and variance of K_{n,m}, and the m>1 excess over mX_n(1-X_n), therefore rest on a step that is asserted but not proved.

ED26-P15-CH-polya-urns-and-beta-prediction-C009 (partial): The entry does not preserve the identified source variant, although every mathematical clause is stated and proved (annex 239-280). The held source (Durrett PTE5, printed p. 227, PDF p. 235) displays the unscaled cell probability P(G_n=m+2)=[n!/(m!(n-m)!)][(m+1)!(n-m)!/((n+2)!/2)] -> 2x for c=1, g=2, r=1. The entry states nP(G_n=s_n+2)->2x and P(G_n=s_n+2)->0 (body 192-197, annex 272-279) and says the annex 'retains the source's direct finite-mass route to both limits' (body 198). Neither the entry, its annex, nor def:p15-polya-source-scope records the source's own reading or that the factor n corrects it. The held text contains neither the scaled limit nor P->0, so it does not support crediting the source with a route to both stated limits.

ED26-P15-CH-polya-urns-and-beta-prediction-C010 (partial): The definitions and worked-boundary elements are missing for the boundary processes the entry makes claims about. def:p15-polya-process (body line 17) and thm:p15-polya-construction cover only g,r,c>0. The entry (body 209-217) states laws and limits for 'the separately defined zero-reinforcement process c=0' and for c>=0 with g=0<r or r=0<g. No definition on the route supplies these processes or extends the transition rule or the uniform construction to c=0 or to a zero initial weight. The only claim that one exists is the entry's own phrase, repeated in handbook/generated/symbol-index.tex:2611. The annex (lines 315-323) applies the construction there without stating an extension, so the failure condition 'unstated assumption' holds. The scaling, c->0, c->infinity and zero-total-weight clauses are fully written (annex 285-313, 322-323).
